```{r loading packages}
  library(ggplot2)  
  library(lme4)

  library(sf)
  library(mapdata)
```

```{r load in data}
NativeResponse.e <- read_csv("~/IAPM Project/MAISRC-IAPM/analysis/CLP_Trt_NativePlantResponse/NativeResponse.e.csv")
NativeResponse.p <- read_csv("~/IAPM Project/MAISRC-IAPM/analysis/CLP_Trt_NativePlantResponse/NativeResponse.p.csv")

pcri.e <- read_csv("~/IAPM Project/MAISRC-IAPM/analysis/MVerhoeven_2020_model/2026 data/pcri.e.csv")
pcri.p <- read_csv("~/IAPM Project/MAISRC-IAPM/analysis/MVerhoeven_2020_model/2026 data/pcri.p.csv")
```


```{r creating datasets}
#making native response combined early and late season survey datasets for only >15% littoral treatments
Treated_NativeResponse.e <- NativeResponse.e %>%
  filter(
    (perc.lit.chem < 0.1 | perc.lit.chem > 14.9),
    !is.na(yutrt)
  ) %>%
  mutate(lag1 = as.numeric(lag1))

Treated_NativeResponse.p <- NativeResponse.p %>%
  filter(
    (perc.lit.chem < 0.1 | perc.lit.chem > 14.9),
    !is.na(yutrt)
  )

Treated_NativeResponse_combined <- bind_rows(Treated_NativeResponse.e, Treated_NativeResponse.p)

Treated_NativeResponse_combined <- Treated_NativeResponse_combined %>%
  mutate(SURVEY_START = mdy(SURVEY_START)) %>%
  mutate(trt_date_lag0 = mdy(trt_date_lag0))


Treated_NativeResponse_combined <- Treated_NativeResponse_combined %>%
  filter(month(SURVEY_START) != 4 | is.na(SURVEY_START))


Treated_NativeResponse_combined <- Treated_NativeResponse_combined %>%
  rename(lag0_APM_perc_lit = APM_perc_lit) %>%
  mutate(APM_perc_lit = coalesce(lag1_APM_perc_lit, lag0_APM_perc_lit)) %>%
  mutate(APM_perc_lit = pmin(APM_perc_lit, 100)) #make any % permitted above 100 be 100

  Treated_NativeResponse_combined <- Treated_NativeResponse_combined %>% mutate(obs = row_number())

#making P. cripsus combined early and late season survey datasets for only >15% littoral treatments
Treated_pcri.e <- pcri.e %>%
  filter(
    (perc.lit.chem < 0.1 | perc.lit.chem > 14.9),
    !is.na(yutrt)
  ) %>%
  mutate(lag1 = as.numeric(lag1))

Treated_pcri.p <- pcri.p %>%
  filter(
    (perc.lit.chem < 0.1 | perc.lit.chem > 14.9),
    !is.na(yutrt)
  )

LargeTrt_pcri_combined <- bind_rows(Treated_pcri.p, Treated_pcri.e)

LargeTrt_pcri_combined <- LargeTrt_pcri_combined %>%
  mutate(SURVEY_START = mdy(SURVEY_START)) %>%
  mutate(trt_date_lag0 = mdy(trt_date_lag0))


write.csv(LargeTrt_pcri_combined, file = "~/IAPM Project/MAISRC-IAPM/analysis/UMISC_Melina/LargeTrt_pcri_combined.csv")
write.csv(Treated_NativeResponse_combined, file = "~/IAPM Project/MAISRC-IAPM/analysis/UMISC_Melina/Treated_NativeResponse_combined.csv")

```


```{r Native response test visuals and summary stats}
#' Visualize the distributions of the responses we are interested in:
  #foc: shown with my calcs(gray) and Adam's calcs (red)
  ggplot(NativeResponse.e, aes(native_vegetated))+
      geom_histogram(alpha = .5)
  ggplot(NativeResponse.p, aes(native_vegetated))+
      geom_histogram(alpha = .5)
  
  
  n_distinct(Treated_NativeResponse_combined$Lake.ID) #35

```
```{r Native response visuals}

#violin plot proportion native-vegetated
ggplot(Treated_NativeResponse_combined, aes(x = cytrt, y = native_vegetated, group = cytrt, fill = cytrt)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()

#boxplot native richness
ggplot(Treated_NativeResponse_combined, aes(x = cytrt, y = survey_native_rich, group = cytrt, fill = cytrt)) +
  geom_boxplot(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()

#boxplot proportion native-vegetated
ggplot(Treated_NativeResponse_combined, aes(x = cytrt, y = native_vegetated, group = cytrt, fill = cytrt)) +
  geom_boxplot(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 1.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal()

#linear model native vegetated
 lm_NativeVegetated_cytrt <- lm(native_vegetated ~ cytrt, data = Treated_NativeResponse_combined)
  summary(lm_NativeVegetated_cytrt)
  
  ggplot(Treated_NativeResponse_combined, aes(x = cytrt, y = native_vegetated)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
    labs(
      x = "Consecutive Years Treated",
      y = "Proportion Native Vegetated",
      title = "Proportion Native Vegetated vs. Consecutive Treatment History"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
#lm native richness  
   lm_NativeRichness_cytrt <- lm(survey_native_rich ~ cytrt, data = Treated_NativeResponse_combined)
  summary(lm_NativeRichness_cytrt)
  
  ggplot(Treated_NativeResponse_combined, aes(x = cytrt, y = survey_native_rich)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
    labs(
      x = "Consecutive Years Treated",
      y = "Native Richness",
      title = "Native Richness vs. Consecutive Treatment History"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  
ggplot(Treated_NativeResponse.p, aes(x = factor(Trt), y = native_vegetated, fill = factor(Trt))) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.7, color = "black") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("0" = "Control (0)", "1" = "Treatment (1)")) +
  labs(
    x = "Treated",
    y = "Proportion Native Vegetated",
    fill = "Trt"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

#lm for native vegetated and percent littoral APM 
 lm_NativeVegetated_APM <- lm(native_vegetated ~ APM_perc_lit, data = Treated_NativeResponse_combined)
  summary(lm_NativeVegetated_APM)
  
  ggplot(Treated_NativeResponse_combined, aes(x = APM_perc_lit, y = native_vegetated)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +

    ) +

  #lm for native richness and percent littoral APM 
 lm_NativeRichness_APM <- lm(survey_native_rich ~ APM_perc_lit, data = Treated_NativeResponse_combined)
```
